title: Find Occurrences of an Element in an Array
summary: Given an integer array nums, an integer array queries, and an integer x, for each query in queries, find the index of the queries[i]-th occurrence of x in nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums, an integer array queries, and an integer x, for each query in queries, find the index of the queries[i]-th occurrence of x in nums. If x does not occur queries[i] times, return -1 for that query. Return an array of answers corresponding to each query.
constraints: nums and queries are nonempty; every query is a positive occurrence rank.
Occurrences are numbered from one in left-to-right order, while returned array indices are zero-based.
Return -1 when the requested occurrence of x does not exist.
hints: All queries ask about the same value, so scan nums once and store its occurrence positions.
Translate each one-based requested rank to positions[rank-1] after a bounds check.
positions=[i for i if nums[i]==x]; map q to positions[q-1] or -1.
The positions list is in occurrence order, making its rank-to-index correspondence exact.
editorial: The positions list is in occurrence order, making its rank-to-index correspondence exact.

tests.explanation: The first and second ones occur at indices zero and two; the third and fourth do not exist.
The third two is at index two and the first is at index zero.
